faq.q: How much does Banker's Hill Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Banker's Hill Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Banker's Hill Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Banker's Hill Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock, the firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Banker's Hill Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Banker's Hill Law Firm publishes one office, in San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
